questions.question: By decreasing 15° of each angle of a triangle, the ratios of their angles are 2:3:5, The radian measure of greatest angle is:
questions.solution:
After decreasing 15° from each angle of triangle let the values of corresponding angles be 2x, 3x and 5x so that their ratio would be 2x:3x:5x or 2:3:5.

Thus the value of angles of triangle must be (2x + 15°), (3x + 15°) and (5x + 15°).

We know that,

Sum of angles of triangle = 180°

∴(2x + 15°) + (3x + 15°) + (5x + 15°) = 180°

⇒ 10x + 45° = 180°

⇒ x = 13.5°

Hence, the value of the greatest angle of triangle = 5x + 15°

= 5 × 13.5 + 15

= 82.5°

= frac{{82.5}}{{180}} times pi 

=11π/24

Hence, the radian measure of greatest angle is 11π/24

questions.question: if 20% of A = 30% of B = 1/6 of C, then A ∶ B ∶ C is
questions.solution:
__Shortcut Trick__

Given: 20% of A = 30% of B = 1/6 of C

⇒ A / 5 = 3B / 10 = C / 6

Divide by the LCM of numerators (1, 3, 1), which is 3:

⇒ A / (5 × 3) = B / 10 = C / (6 × 3)

⇒ A / 15 = B / 10 = C / 18

**∴ The correct answer is 15 : 10 : 18.**

**__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

20% of A = 30% of B = 1/6 of C

**Formula Used:**

Percentage to fraction: P% = P / 100

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/d2282247fbe1d445fc97a7d28343cc17e226fe8ddb2ed4483056045d67caf71f.png] 

**Calculations:**

⇒ (20 / 100) × A = (30 / 100) × B = (1 / 6) × C

⇒ (1 / 5) × A = (3 / 10) × B = (1 / 6) × C

Let (1 / 5) × A = (3 / 10) × B = (1 / 6) × C = k

⇒ A = 5k

⇒ B = 10k / 3

⇒ C = 6k

Now, finding the ratio A : B : C

⇒ A : B : C = 5k : 10k / 3 : 6k

Cancel out k from all terms:

⇒ A : B : C = 5 : 10 / 3 : 6

Multiply the entire ratio by 3 to remove the denominator:

⇒ A : B : C = (5 × 3) : 10 : (6 × 3)

⇒ A : B : C = 15 : 10 : 18

**∴ The correct answer is 15 : 10 : 18.**

**__Additional Information__**

Compound Ratio

When two or more ratios are multiplied together, the resulting ratio is called a compound ratio. For a:b and c:d, the compound ratio is ac:bd.

Duplicate Ratio

The duplicate ratio of a:b is defined as the square of the given ratio, i.e., a²:b².

Invertendo Property

If a:b = c:d, then by the invertendo property, b:a = d:c.

questions.question: An article was subject to three successive discounts, whereby a customer had to pay ₹ 2,366.8 less than the marked price of ₹ 12,500. If the rates of the first two discounts were, respectively, 12% and 6%, then what was the rate percentage of the third discount?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Final Selling Price (SP) = 12500 − 2366.8 = 10133.2

Using successive multiplying factors: 12500 × 0.88 × 0.94 × (1 − d/100) = 10133.2

⇒ 10340 × (1 − d/100) = 10133.2

Third discount value = 10340 − 10133.2 = 206.8

Third discount % = (206.8 ÷ 10340) × 100 = 2%

**∴ The correct answer is 2%.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Marked Price (MP) = ₹12,500

Total discount = ₹2,366.8

First discount (d₁) = 12%

Second discount (d₂) = 6%

Let the third discount be d₃%

**Calculations:**

⇒ Selling Price (SP) = MP − Total Discount

⇒ SP = 12500 − 2366.8 = 10133.2

⇒ Price after 1st discount = 12500 × (100 − 12) ÷ 100 = 12500 × 0.88 = 11000

⇒ Price after 2nd discount = 11000 × (100 − 6) ÷ 100 = 11000 × 0.94 = 10340

⇒ Price after 3rd discount = 10340 × (100 − d₃) ÷ 100 = 10133.2

⇒ 10340 − 103.4d₃ = 10133.2

⇒ 103.4d₃ = 10340 − 10133.2 = 206.8

⇒ d₃ = 206.8 ÷ 103.4 = 2

**∴ The correct answer is 2%.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Successive Discount

When two or more discounts are applied sequentially on the Marked Price, they are called successive discounts. The formula for effective discount of two successive discounts d₁ and d₂ is: D = d₁ + d₂ − (d₁ × d₂) ÷ 100.

Selling Price Formula

For a sequence of three discounts d₁%, d₂%, and d₃%, the Final Selling Price is given by: SP = MP × (1 − d₁/100) × (1 − d₂/100) × (1 − d₃/100).

Marked Price (MP) vs Selling Price (SP)

Marked Price is the listed price of the article. Selling Price is the price at which it is actually sold after applying all discounts. Discount = MP − SP.

questions.question: If the rate of interest is 10% per annum and is compounded half yearly, the principal of Rs. 400 in 3/2 years will amount to
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Rate per half-year = 10% ÷ 2 = 5% = 1/20.

Time = 3/2 years = 3 half-yearly cycles.

Multiplying factor for 3 cycles = (21/20) × (21/20) × (21/20) = 9261/8000.

Amount = Principal × Multiplying factor = 400 × (9261/8000).

Amount = 9261 ÷ 20 = 463.05.

**∴ The correct answer is Rs. 463.05.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Principal (P) = Rs. 400

Rate of Interest (R) = 10% per annum

Time (T) = 3/2 years

**Formula Used:**

When interest is compounded half-yearly, Amount (A) = P × (1 + (R ÷ 2)/100)²T

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/b550211a8740bc00a7b286c7043ce3df551ea4cb2cf88c83515f1cf5c1d34729.png] 

**Calculations:**

⇒ Effective Rate (r) = 10% ÷ 2 = 5% per half-year

⇒ Number of cycles (n) = (3/2) × 2 = 3

⇒ A = 400 × (1 + 5/100)³

⇒ A = 400 × (105/100)³

⇒ A = 400 × (21/20) × (21/20) × (21/20)

⇒ A = 400 × (9261/8000)

⇒ A = 9261 ÷ 20

⇒ A = 463.05

**∴ The correct answer is Rs. 463.05.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Quarterly Compounding

If interest is compounded quarterly, the rate becomes one-fourth (R ÷ 4) and the time periods become four times (4T).

Effective CI Rate for 2 Cycles

For a rate of x% per cycle, the effective compound interest rate for 2 consecutive cycles is calculated as: [x + x + (x² ÷ 100)]%.

Difference between CI and SI

The difference between Compound Interest and Simple Interest for exactly 2 periods on a principal P at rate R is: Difference = P × (R ÷ 100)².

questions.question: A group of men decided to complete a job in 4 days. However, since 10 men dropped out every day, the job got completed at the end of the 7th day. How many men were there in the beginning?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Days to complete job initially = 4

Actual days taken = 7

Men dropping out each day = 10

**Formula used:**

Total Work = Initial Number of Men × Days × Daily Work Rate

Let Initial Number of Men = x

Total Work = x × 4

**Calculations:**

On Day 1: Men = x, Work done = x

On Day 2: Men = x - 10, Work done = x - 10

On Day 3: Men = x - 20, Work done = x - 20

On Day 4: Men = x - 30, Work done = x - 30

On Day 5: Men = x - 40, Work done = x - 40

On Day 6: Men = x - 50, Work done = x - 50

On Day 7: Men = x - 60, Work done = x - 60

Total Work done = x + (x - 10) + (x - 20) + (x - 30) + (x - 40) + (x - 50) + (x - 60)

⇒ Total Work = 7x - (10 + 20 + 30 + 40 + 50 + 60)

⇒ Total Work = 7x - 210

**Setting the total work equal:**

x × 4 = 7x - 210

⇒ 4x = 7x - 210

⇒ 3x = 210

⇒ x = 70

**∴ Initial Number of Men = 70**

questions.question: Sicily has a population of 12000 with a male and female ratio of 2 : 3. If the yearly increase in the male population is 10% p.a. and that of females is 15% p.a. Find the population of Sicily after 3 years (to the nearest tenth)?
questions.solution:
Concept:

The population of an area grows in a compounding manner. Hence, the population can be found using the compound interest formula after a particular time.

**Formula:**

Total population = P × (1 + Rover100)T where,

P= Initial population

R = Rate of population increase

T = Time in years.

**Calculation:**

Total male population in Sicily = 2over 5 × 12,000 = 4800

Total female population in Sicily = 3over 5 × 12,000 = 7200

Total male population in Sicily after 3 years-

⇒ 4800 × (1 + 10over 100)³

⇒ 4800 × 11over 10 × 11over 10 × 11over 10 = 6,389

Total female population in Sicily after 3 years-

⇒ 7200 × (1 + 15over 100)3

⇒ 7200 × 23over 20 × 23over 20 × 23over 20 = 10,950

Total population of Sicily after 3 years-

⇒ 6,389 + 10,950 = 17,340 (rounded off to the nearest tenth)

∴ **Total population of Sicily after 3 years is 17,340.**

questions.question: A and B started a business together. A invested Rs. 36000 for 8 months while B invested some capital for 6 months. In the end B got 15/31 of the total profit, then how much money did B invest?
questions.solution:
**Formula Used:**

A's Share + B's Share = Total Share

A's Percentage = A's Share/ Total Share × 100

B's Percentage = B's Share/Total Share × 100

**Explanation:**

Given: A's investment = Rs. 36000 for 8 months

Let B's investment = Rs. x for 6 months

The profit-sharing ratio is based on both the capital invested and the time for which it was invested.

So, the ratio of their investments and time would be:

A's ratio = (36000 × 8)

B's ratio = (x × 6)

Total Profit = 36000 × 8 + x × 6

Now, it is given that B got 15/31 of the total profit. This means that the ratio of B's share of profit to the total profit is 15/31.

So, we can set up the following equation:

(B's share of profit) / (Total profit) = 15/31

⇒ [(x × 6) / (36000 × 8 + x × 6)] = 15/31

⇒ 31 × (x × 6) = 15 × (36000 × 8 + x × 6)

⇒ 186x = 15 × (36000 × 8 + 6x)

⇒ 186x = 15 × (288000 + 6x)

⇒ 186x = 4320000 + 90x

⇒ 96x = 4320000

⇒ x = 4320000 / 96

⇒ x = 45,000

**So, B invested Rs. 45,000 in the business.**

questions.question: A train moves at a speed of 30 m/s and crosses a bridge of length 650 metres in 50 seconds. What is the length of the train?
questions.solution:
Given:

Train speed = 30 m/s

Bridge length = 650 m

Time to cross = 50 s

**Concept:**

The total distance covered when a train crosses a bridge is the sum of the length of the train and the length of the bridge. This total distance is equal to the speed of the train times the time it takes to cross the bridge.

**Solution:**

Total distance covered = speed × time = 30 × 50 = 1500 m

Length of train = total distance - bridge length = 1500 - 650 = 850 m

**Hence, the length of the train is 850 metres (Option 3).**

questions.question: A thief seeing a policeman from a distance of 525 metres started running at a speed of 18 km/h. The policeman chased him immediately with a speed of 27 km/h. What is twice the distance covered by the policeman to catch the thief?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Initial distance between thief and policeman = 525 m

Speed of thief = 18 km/h = 18 x 1000 ÷ 3600 = 5 m/s

Speed of policeman = 27 km/h = 27 x 1000 ÷ 3600 = 7.5 m/s

**Formula used:**

Relative Speed = Policeman speed − Thief speed

Time = Distance ÷ Relative Speed

Distance covered = Policeman speed x Time

Twice the distance = 2 x (Distance covered by policeman)

**Calculations:**

Relative Speed = 7.5 − 5 = 2.5 m/s

Time = 525 ÷ 2.5 = 210 sec

Distance covered = 7.5 x 210 = 1575 m

Twice the distance = 2 x 1575 = 3150 m

**∴ Twice the distance covered by the policeman to catch the thief is 3150 metres.**

questions.question: M, N, and O can do work in 22, 24, and 16 days respectively. If they work for a day alternately such that M works on the first day, N works on the second day, O works on the third day and then again M works on the fourth day and so on, then in how many days approximately, the work will be completed?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

M, N, and O can do work in 22, 24, and 16 days respectively

**Solution:**

Work done by M in one day = 1/22

Work done by N in one day = 1/24

Work done by O in one day = 1/16

Total work done in one cycle of three days = (1/22) + (1/24) + (1/16)

Total number of days to finish the work = 3/((1/22)+(1/24)+(1/16))

⇒ Total days = 3/(0.045 + 0.0417 + 0.0625)

⇒ Total days = 3/0.1492

⇒ Total days = 20.1 days

**Therefore, the work will be completed in approximately 20 days.**

questions.question: Find the number of solid spheres, each of diameter 6 cm, that can be made by melting a solid metal cylinder of height 12 cm and diameter 6 cm.
questions.solution:
**Given**

Cylinder dimensions: Height = 12 cm, Diameter = 6 cm

Sphere diameter: 6 cm

**Concept: **Volume calculation and comparison.

**Calculation:**

Cylinder volume = πr²h = π3²12 = 108π cm³

Sphere volume = 4/3πr³ = 4/3π3³ = 36π cm³

Number of spheres = Cylinder volume/Sphere volume

108π/36π = 3

**Hence, 3 solid spheres can be made.**

questions.question: A vessel is filled with liquid, 3 parts of which are water and 5 parts syrup. How much of the mixture must be drawn off and replaced with water so that the mixture may be half water and half syrup?
questions.solution:
Given:

A vessel is filled with liquid, 3 parts of which are water and 5 parts syrup. 

Calculation:

Ratio of water to syrup in the mixture = 3 : 5

Let be 8x litres of mixture initially and P litres of mixture is drawn off and replaced with water.

Amount of water in 8x litres = 8x × 3/(3 + 5) = 3x litres

Amount of syrup in 8x litres = 8x × 5/(3 + 5) = 5x litres

Amount of water in P litres = P × 3/(3 + 5) = 3P/8 litres

Amount of syrup in P litres = P × 5/(3 + 5) = 5P/8 litres

According to the question,

(3x - 3P/8 + P) = (5x - 5P/8)

⇒ 2P/8 + P = 2x

⇒ 5P/4 = 2x

⇒ P = 8x/5

⇒ P = Original Quantity × 1/5

**∴ 1/5 of the mixture must be drawn off and replaced with water so that the mixture may be half water and half syrup.**

questions.question: There are 15 students in a class. The average age of the students and the teacher of the class is 15 years. The average age of the teacher and the students is 2 years more than that of students. What is the age of the class teacher?

⇒ Average = (sum of all the observation) / (Total number of observation)

**Explanation:-**

Suppose the age of the class teacher is x years.

Also, let sum of ages of students is y years.

⇒ (y / 15) + 2 = 15 

⇒ y =13 × 15 

⇒ y = 195

Put this value in equation (1),

⇒ (x + y) = 240

⇒ (x + 195) = 240

⇒ x = 45 years

So, the age of the class teacher is 45 years.

Hence, the correct option is 4.

questions.question: The least number of square tiles required to pave the ceiling of a room 525 centimetre long and 378 centimetre broad is:
questions.solution:
**Given:**

The dimensions of the ceiling are 525 cm long and 378 cm broad.

**Formula Used:**

The number of tiles required is given by: Number of tiles = (Length of ceiling) / (Side of square tile) × (Breadth of ceiling) / (Side of square tile)

**Calculation:**

First, find the GCD of 525 and 378.

Using the Euclidean algorithm:

525 = 378 × 1 + 147

378 = 147 × 2 + 84

147 = 84 × 1 + 63

84 = 63 × 1 + 21

63 = 21 × 3 + 0

So, the GCD is 21.

The side of the largest square tile is 21 cm.

Number of tiles required:

Number of tiles = (525) / (21) × (378) / (21)

Number of tiles = 25 × 18

Number of tiles = 450

**∴ The correct answer is 450.**
